name: "BLT" Tacos with Bacon, Lettuce, Tomato, Cucumber & Blue Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 hearts romaine hearts
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallots. Place in a large bowl along with dressing and ketchup. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
⅓ cup ranch dressing
3 tbsp ketchup

instructions.primary_message: Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates and fill with a small portion of the salad, then top with crispy bacon and blue cheese. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled blue cheese
